display_guidance.numeric_format: Signed four-decimal effect and 95% CI; retain full precision in Excel/source data. Use additional digits if needed for a narrow interval.
display_guidance.metric_separation: Do not pool agreement, specificity, AP, mAP, overlap, direction agreement or trajectory concordance.
display_guidance.method_names: Observed=Raw; IMR=historical frozen Teacher; Cross-modal update=historical full updated estimate. CFRA applies only to its genuine Student-label and direct-transfer experiments.
display_guidance.sample_unit: Compounds/drugs, not wells, seed runs or pooled modality rows. Macro transfer rows include the same drug set in each of three targets.
display_guidance.module_scope: Six structural modules plus one cross-channel feature group. Module-specific update contrasts and the seven-group module macro remain in original/figure source tables; omitted here to keep 29 primary rows.

not_evaluated_notes.reason: Required complete frozen probe-set-to-gene mapping and GE-A-only update were unavailable.
No candidate met the prespecified validation-only compactness and stability requirements.
